verdict.rationale: Elicit serves a complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Elicit API" v2.0.0, 46 paths) at docs.elicit.com/openapi.json, and it backs a vendor-hosted Scalar reference. The probe 404s were on the support.elicit.com subdomain, a different host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: the spec is not advertised as an explicit download link (it sits at the docs root), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Elicit serves a full OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Elicit API", version 2.0.0; 46 paths across Search, Sessions, Reports, Systematic Reviews, Research Agent and more; server https://elicit.com/api/v2)
Elicit vendor-hosts a Scalar API reference ("Elicit API Reference — Complete API reference for the Elicit research automation platform") embedding the spec.
